decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a durable, high-quality portable speaker for outdoor use. My consideration set includes a mix of premium brands (JBL, Bose, B&O) and highly-rated budget alternatives (Comiso, INSMY). I filtered out several accessory-only listings (cases, cables, and adapters) and gimmicky products like levitating speakers. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it has an outstanding reputation (4.8 stars with over 16,000 reviews), excellent battery life (20 hours), and IP67 waterproofing. While the B&O Beosound is an excellent audiophile choice, the JBL's ruggedness and powerbank feature provide better utility for my needs at a more accessible price point than the extreme luxury bracket.
